court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: 17th M.M. Court at Borivali, Mumbai - C.R. No.79 of 2015
case_name: Himanshu Gajendraprakash Mathur And ... v. The State Of Maharashtra And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra and Respondent No.2

facts_of_case: The Applicants sought to quash the proceedings in respect of CC No.1702378/PW/2015 pending before the Hon'ble Court of 17th M.M. Court at Borivali, Mumbai arising out of C.R. No.79 of 2015, registered with Samta Nagar Police Station, Mumbai for the offences u/s.498-A, 406 and 34 of Indian Penal Code.

legal_principles.principle: Consent of parties is a material consideration for quashing proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The Respondent No.2 has given consent for quashing the FIR and the proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: Marriage between parties has been dissolved by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: The marriage between the Applicant No.1 and the Respondent No.2 has been dissolved by mutual consent.

outcome.final_order: The marriage between the Applicant No.1 and Respondent No.2 has been dissolved by mutual consent.
